_note: Deterministic platform order for 'Where to post first'. Only platforms the lead picked are listed, highest weight first. Ties keep the order below.

lead.buyer: Start with {first}. Add the others once the first clips are moving.
lead.buyerOne: Start with {first} and put the whole first wave there.
lead.clipper: Post on {first} first. Add the others once you know which clips work.

tiktok.name: TikTok
tiktok.buyer: The feed shows clips to people who do not follow anyone yet, so a new song, product or moment can reach strangers on day one.
tiktok.clipper: New accounts can reach people fast, because the feed does not wait for followers. Good for testing which clips work.

instagram_reels.name: Instagram Reels
instagram_reels.buyer: Reels sit next to Stories, profiles and links, so people who like a clip can find you, follow you and buy in a few taps.
instagram_reels.clipper: Reels reward clean, well edited clips. Many campaigns ask for Reels, so it is worth having an account ready.

youtube_shorts.name: YouTube Shorts
youtube_shorts.buyer: Shorts keep getting views for longer, and they point people to full videos, podcasts and streams on the same platform.
youtube_shorts.clipper: Shorts can keep picking up views for weeks after you post, which matters when you are paid per counted view.

x.name: X
x.buyer: X moves fast around news, sport and culture. It works best next to a moment people are already talking about.
x.clipper: X is good for timely clips: a goal, a quote, a moment from last night. Speed matters more than polish there.
